extraction: ECC OpenCode Plugin Details: v1.3.0 (Feb 2026) adds full OpenCode integration. 12 agents, 24 commands, 16 skills with hook support via OpenCode's plugin system (20+ event types). 3 native custom tools: run-tests, check-coverage, security-audit. Plugin config: 'everything-claude-code@everything-claude-code': true in opencode.jsonc.
